resources.string: This text will be copied to the clipboard on your PC:
Open FeatherCast and pair with your PC first.
Make sure FeatherCast runs and both are on the same Wi-Fi.
Android may be putting FeatherCast to sleep
The connection to your PC keeps dropping. Allow FeatherCast to run in the background so it can reconnect.
Local network access is needed to connect to your PC.
Messages and alerts appear on the PC, and you can reply from there.
Your newest photos can be opened on the PC.
Only your selected photos are shared. You can change the selection.
Text copied on the PC is copied on the phone. Use “Send clipboard” for the other way.
Files sent from the PC are saved to Download/FeatherCast.
The PC can make this phone ring loudly, even when it is on silent.
See what is playing and control it from the PC.
Read and send SMS from the PC. Contacts are used to show names instead of numbers.
Incoming calls show on the PC with the contact\'s name, where you can reject or silence them.
Browse the phone\'s files from the PC and download them.
Open Phone Screen on your PC. You approve each session here before your screen is shared.
Allow your paired PC to tap, swipe and navigate during an approved screen sharing session.
FeatherCast PC Keyboard is selected. Type directly in phone apps from your PC.
Enable FeatherCast PC Keyboard in Android settings, then select it for direct PC typing.
Device audio is requested when you share. Some apps do not allow audio capture.
This Android version supports screen sharing without device audio.
If Android blocks the accessibility setting after installing the APK, open FeatherCast\'s App info and allow restricted settings first.
Allow notifications to see connection status in the notification drawer. Connecting does not require this permission.
Nothing yet. Text you copy on the PC shows up here.
Shows the PC clipboard once connected.

This removes the pairing with %1$s and stops everything this phone shares with it: notifications, photos, clipboard, files and the rest. You can pair again at any time by scanning the code on your PC.
%1$s wants to show this phone\'s screen on the PC. Only share it if you just started Phone Screen on your PC.
This is only sent to your paired PC over your local network. It is never sent anywhere else.
FeatherCast reads the notifications on this phone, including their text and which media is playing, so your PC can show them, let you reply, and control playback.
FeatherCast reads your newest photos. Small previews go to the PC, and a full photo is sent only when you open it there.
Photos and videos (or only the photos you select)
FeatherCast reads your text messages and can send SMS when you ask from the PC. Your contacts are used only to show names instead of numbers.
SMS (read, send and receive) and Contacts
FeatherCast sees incoming calls, who is calling (with the contact\'s name) and the call log, and lets the PC reject or silence a ringing call.
Phone state, Call log, Contacts and Answer phone calls
This is the broadest access in FeatherCast. The PC can browse every folder in the phone\'s storage and download any file in it, except other apps\' private data. Turn it off whenever you like.
All files access (opens Android settings; on Android 10 and older, Files and media)
Nothing is shared with your PC until you decide. Android asks for permissions only for the things you turn on.
You can change this any time on the main screen.
Reconnects automatically when the PC is on the same Wi-Fi.
Allow local network access to connect to your PC.
Allow local network access to pair with your PC.
Could not reach %1$s. Make sure the phone is on the same Wi-Fi and FeatherCast is allowed through the Windows firewall.
This pairing code has expired. Show a new one on the PC and scan again.
The pairing code did not match. Scan the code again.
The PC no longer knows this phone. If you removed it on the PC, choose “Unpair this phone” below and pair again.
Files must be 8 GB or smaller.
The file changed or could not be read completely.
File transfer cancelled or the connection was lost.
Up to four files can be sent at once.
The PC did not confirm the saved file.
The PC could not save the file.
Receiving files is turned off on the phone.
Allow FeatherCast to save files on the phone.
Allow phone storage access or choose an available file.
Allow photo access in FeatherCast on your phone.
The previous screen sharing request was replaced.
Enable Screen sharing in the FeatherCast app on your phone.
Your PC requests screen sharing. Tap Share screen to approve it.
Open FeatherCast to share your screen with %1$s.
The request expired. Start Phone Screen again on your PC.
Connecting your screen to the PC…
Your screen is shared with the PC. You can stop sharing at any time.
Connection lost. Start a new screen sharing session on your PC.
Android could not start screen sharing. Start a new request on your PC.
Screen sharing was declined or the request expired.
